The '''EU LCS 2015 Summer Split''' was the sixth split of the [[European League of Legends Championship Series]] (EU LCS), organized by Riot Games. The regular season took place from May 28 to August 23, 2015, with matches held at the EU LCS Studio in Berlin, while the Playoffs concluded at Hovet Arena in Stockholm, Sweden. Ten teams competed in a Double Round-Robin Best-of-One format, with the top six advancing to the Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoffs. The split featured a $100,000 USD prize pool, and the champion earned a direct qualification to the [[Worlds 2015|2015 World Championship]], while the eight and ninth place were sent to the [[LCS/Europe/2016/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]] and last place is relegated to [[Challenger Series/Europe/2016/Spring|Challenger Series]].

Between the Spring and Summer splits there were several roster and lineup moves and promotion/relegation matches that reshaped the Summer field. [[Origen]] secured an EU LCS spot by winning the [[Challenger Series/Europe/2015/Spring|Challenger Series]] and joined the league as a new organization built around [[xPeke]]. The Summer Promotion featured [[Giants Gaming]] vs [[Reason Gaming]] and [[Team ROCCAT]] vs [[Copenhagen Wolves Academy]]; Giants defeated Reason and ROCCAT swept Copenhagen Wolves Academy to join/retain their LCS positions for Summer.
